brand_archetype: Doom Metal Forge x Tactical Spectral Arsenal (Wales Gothic / Industrial Black Metal)
emotional_tone: Ominous, heavyweight, precision-forged, electrifying, atmospheric, accessible
app_type: hybrid_fullstack marketing + rental app (React 18 + Vite + Tailwind 3 + Three.js / R3F / Postprocessing)
instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this document strictly to transform Llanfair Spectre Forge into a top-1% hackathon-winning experience.
Refine the theme to Ember Orange (#ff4a1c) & Spectral Cyan/Mint (#00f5a0 & #22ff88) paired with deep Obsidian/Iron and aged Brass.

Typography: Reserve Blackletter / Gothic ('UnifrakturMaguntia' or 'Cinzel Decorative') strictly for heroic brand titles and key section accents. For primary UI headings and subheadings, use bold chiseled serif 'Cinzel' or 'Space Grotesk' with tight tracking. For body text, use highly readable 'Space Grotesk' or 'Inter' with loose leading so legibility is paramount and WCAG AA contrast is satisfied.

Strictly avoid emoji icons anywhere in the UI (no 🤖, 🧠, 💡, 🔮, 🎯, etc.). Use only Lucide icons (Flame, Skull, Zap, Radio, MapPin, Package, ShieldCheck, Disc3, Eye, Plus, RotateCw, Volume2, VolumeX, etc.).

All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles, cards, drawer items, modals, manifests, links) MUST have explicit kebab-case `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-rent-rig-button', data-testid='crate-drawer-checkout-button').
Ensure dark-only aesthetic with WCAG AA compliance (4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large headers and buttons). Never use transparent backgrounds on headers, drawers, or modals that allow content bleed.
Support Adaptive Eco 3D Mode: auto-detect mobile viewports (<768px) or low-power indicators, while providing an accessible manual toggle in the navigation bar.
Ensure the Sunn O))) 55Hz drone synth is MUTED by default with a visible, accessible toggle in the header.

Rental flow must be seamless: 6 catalog cards -> interactive 3D inspection modal -> Add to Crate toast + persistent crate badge -> Crate Drawer with multi-day discount calculation (15% off 3+ nights) -> Booking manifest generation -> Manifest lookup modal with cancellation support.

visual_enhancers.welsh_station_signboard: Iconic 58-letter Welsh village name sign (Llanfairpwllgwyngyllgogerychwyrndrobwllllantysiliogogogoch) styled as a forged iron & brass railway marker with rivets, inset brass borders and amber beacon lights.

hero_stage.lighting: Studio forge lighting: dual directional rim lights (#fff7ec and #93c5fd), hemisphere light, dynamic accent point-light (boosted in overdrive to 5.2 intensity), floor rift ground glow.

effects.bloom: Bloom luminanceThreshold 0.45, mipmapBlur, intensity 0.95 (normal) / 1.55 (overdrive). Disabled automatically when lowPower (Eco Mode) is active.
effects.vignette: Vignette offset 0.2, darkness 0.9 for dark cinematic stage focus.

hero_stage.rift_floor: Procedural GLSL undulation rift shader with time-based distortion and dynamic overdrive pulse.
hero_stage.instanced_embers: THREE.InstancedMesh rendering 75 ember sparks (28 in Eco Mode) rising and swaying.

catalog_cards.viewport: EquipmentCardViewport component using IntersectionObserver to only render active WebGL viewports when scrolled near view, preventing GPU strain.
catalog_cards.controls: OrbitControls with zoom/pan disabled and gentle damping.

eco_mode.auto_detection: Initial detection on mount: window.innerWidth < 768 or navigator.hardwareConcurrency <= 4 sets lowPower true.
eco_mode.manual_toggle: Navbar 'ECO 3D' vs 'ULTRA 3D' button with state preservation and toast confirmation.

three_d_strategy.fallback: WebGLErrorBoundary wraps 3D canvas with themed fallback: iron-plated dossier card with equipment wireframe visual and full specs.

sound_synth_strategy.toggle_control: Navbar toggle with sound waves / mute icon, status badge '55Hz A1 ON' / 'DOOM AMP'.
sound_synth_strategy.audio_engine: spectralSynth.js (Web Audio API synthesising 55Hz Sunn O))) sub-bass drone with distortion and overdrive harmonic pulse on test fire).

accessibility_and_motion.prefers_reduced_motion: When active, auto-rotation in 3D is disabled, ember particle speed is frozen, and CSS smooth scroll is disabled.
accessibility_and_motion.wcag_aa_compliance: Normal body text contrast >= 4.5:1 against #060608. Interactive buttons use solid fills or high-contrast borders with explicit hover text colors.
accessibility_and_motion.focus_states: All buttons, inputs, and links feature high-visibility outline: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#ff4a1c] focus:outline-none.

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive or data-critical element MUST have data-testid in kebab-case format.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) with opaque tinted backgrounds.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
